title: [Chapitre] VIII. Analysis situs (quatrième mouture) : notes manuscrites (26/06-04/07/1986).

errors: Injectivity is correct, given p. 71's identity X ∈ S ⇔ φ(X) ⊂ φ(S). The parenthetical claim of p. 71 that φ(co-ψ°(A)) equals P∖φ(A) (and not merely is contained in it) needs an extra covering hypothesis: every point outside φ(A) must lie in some |X|° disjoint from φ(A). This holds e.g. when the |X|° of strata partition P. It is not stated on this page.

The proposed replacement of {X : φ(X) ⊂ Q} by its minimal elements / s-pr° is left undetermined, and Grothendieck himself doubts it ('peut-être pas les minimaux'). No characterization of the image of Σ_M is reached on this page.

ideas.what: Closed parts as polars for an apartness relation, with A ∥ B ⇔ φ(A) ∩ φ(B) = ∅, giving a closure system Σ_M
ideas.modern_name: Orthogonality spaces / Galois connection of a symmetric irreflexive relation (polar or biorthogonal closure)

ideas.what: Injective representation S ↦ |S|° of the lattice of closed figure-sets into subsets of a point set, with explicit left inverse Q ↦ {X : |X|° ⊂ Q}
ideas.modern_name: Representation of a closure lattice by an order-embedding into a power set (Galois-connection retraction)

ideas.what: Using open cells |X|° (strata interiors) rather than closed realizations, so that combinatorial disjointness matches point-set disjointness (margin sketch)
ideas.modern_name: Open strata / cell interiors in stratified or CW / tame structures
ideas.usually_credited_to: standard (Whitney, Thom stratifications; o-minimal cell decomposition, van den Dries)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme §5-6 discusses tame topology and dévissage of stratified structures in general terms only

ideas.what: Question of which point-sets Q are images of closed figure-sets, termed 'constructibles'
ideas.modern_name: Definable/constructible sets in a tame topology (o-minimal structures)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (tame topology programme, without this formalism)

missed.claim: Grothendieck sets up a point-free, combinatorial approach to tame topology: cells with an apartness relation, polar-closed 'figures', and an embedding into subsets of points. He leaves open the characterization of the image (the 'constructible' sets) and the right normal form for S_Q (minimal elements vs. s-pr°). This is part of the largely unpublished 1986 'Analysis situs' manuscript and is not developed in the literature as such. The individual steps here are elementary.
missed.quote: S_Q = s-pr°({X ∈ M | φ(X) ⊂ Q}) ... figures (... "constructibles")
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It is a concrete fragment of Grothendieck's own attempt at foundations for tame topology via orthogonality/closure structures. Historians comparing his programme with o-minimality might find it relevant. Mathematically it is routine at this stage.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a routine Galois-connection/closure-system argument (injectivity of S ↦ |S|°) inside Grothendieck's unpublished axiomatic analysis situs. It is historically interesting as a window on his tame-topology programme, but it contains no nontrivial result absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: Line 3 likely reads 'est injective, on trouve un inverse [en] associant, à toute partie Q de P, l'ensemble {X ∈ M | φ(X) ⊂ Q}'. The struck-out symbol before '=' is a deleted name for this set, probably S or S_Q.
'ou plutôt l'ensemble des éléments minimaux (peut-être pas les minimaux mais s-pr°)': the reading of 's-pr°' is uncertain; it is an operator name, not 's-pr' as a word.

Margin sketch labels: 'A ∩ B = ∅' and '|A| ∩ |B| ≠ ∅' (the first label partially struck). The drawing is a hatched lens-shaped 2-cell with a crossing segment and a marked interior point. The margin text begins 'Il me semble ... A ∩ B ... de deux figures ... |B|'.
Page header '72' is Grothendieck's numbering; '81' at bottom is the archive folio.
